milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because honey blocks drop themselves when mined (no silk touch needed). Having a honey_block in inventory confirms the player successfully mined at least one of the 2x2 honey block barrier to enter the room. This is preferred over mine_block event because it directly confirms the item was obtained.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond_pickaxe at the crafting table places it directly into the player's inventory. The player must first retrieve 3 diamonds and 2 sticks from the chest (accessible only after mining honey blocks) and use the crafting table inside the room.

Uses inventory_has because a jukebox only drops itself as an item when mined with a pickaxe (any tier). Without a pickaxe it drops nothing. Having a jukebox in inventory confirms both that the player mined it AND had the required pickaxe tool (the diamond_pickaxe crafted in the previous step).
